name: ES Opening Range VWAP Touch Strategy
description: Intraday ES futures strategy that trades opening range breakouts with VWAP pullbacks. Waits for price to break and hold outside the 9:30-9:45am opening range for 5 minutes, then enters on first touch of NY Open VWAP when price is aligned with both VWAPs.
source:
# ES Opening Range VWAP Touch Strategy
# Intraday ES futures strategy: opening range breakouts with VWAP pullbacks
#
# RULES:
# 1. Opening Range (OR): 9:30-9:45am NY high/low
# 2. Bias: Price must close and stay outside OR for 5 consecutive minutes
#    - Bullish: price above OR high for 5 bars
#    - Bearish: price below OR low for 5 bars
# 3. Entry: First touch of NY Open VWAP (anchored 9:30am) when:
#    - LONG: bullish bias + price above both overnight VWAP (6pm anchor) and NY VWAP
#    - SHORT: bearish bias + price below both VWAPs
# 4. Exit: Close all positions at 3:45pm NY
# 5. Risk: Maximum 1 position per day, single entry only

# Data source - 5 minute bars (per study config)
src = market_data_source(timeframe=5Min)()
close = src.c
high = src.h
low = src.l
volume = src.v

# Typical price for VWAP calculation
typical_price = (high + low + close) / 3

# =============================================================================
# TIME-BASED CONDITIONS
# =============================================================================

# Extract time components from index for session detection
current_time = index()
current_hour = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.hour)(current_time)
current_minute = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.minute)(current_time)

# Time as minutes from midnight for comparison
time_in_minutes = current_hour * 60 + current_minute

# Opening Range: 9:30-9:45am (570-585 minutes from midnight)
is_opening_range = time_in_minutes >= 570 and time_in_minutes < 585

# Trading window: 9:50am-3:45pm (590-945 minutes) - after OR + confirmation
is_trading_window = time_in_minutes >= 590 and time_in_minutes < 945

# Exit time: 3:45pm (945 minutes)
is_exit_time = time_in_minutes >= 945

# NY RTH session open: 9:30am
is_ny_open = time_in_minutes == 570

# New trading day detection - detect when hour goes from late to early (new session)
prev_hour = current_hour >> 1
is_new_day = current_hour < prev_hour or (current_hour == 9 and current_minute == 30 and (current_hour >> 1) != 9)

# =============================================================================
# OPENING RANGE HIGH/LOW (9:30-9:45am)
# =============================================================================

# During opening range, track running high and low using RTH session
or_running_high = session_agg(session=EquityRTHSession, agg=AggregationType.Max)(high)
or_running_low = session_agg(session=EquityRTHSession, agg=AggregationType.Min)(low)

# Capture OR high/low at 9:45am (end of OR period)
# Use valuewhen to capture values when OR ends
or_just_closed = (time_in_minutes >> 1) < 585 and time_in_minutes >= 585
or_high_captured = valuewhen()(condition=or_just_closed, source=or_running_high)
or_low_captured = valuewhen()(condition=or_just_closed, source=or_running_low)

# Forward fill OR levels
or_high_ff = ffill(or_high_captured)
or_low_ff = ffill(or_low_captured)

# =============================================================================
# VWAP CALCULATIONS (Session Anchored)
# =============================================================================

# NY Open VWAP (anchored at RTH open 9:30am)
# VWAP = Cumulative(TP * Volume) / Cumulative(Volume)
ny_cum_tpv = session_agg(session=EquityRTHSession, agg=AggregationType.Sum)(typical_price * volume)
ny_cum_vol = session_agg(session=EquityRTHSession, agg=AggregationType.Sum)(volume)
ny_vwap = ny_cum_tpv / ny_cum_vol

# Overnight VWAP - use cumulative from start of data as approximation
# This creates a running VWAP that includes pre-market/overnight data
on_cum_tpv = cumulative()(typical_price * volume)
on_cum_vol = cumulative()(volume)
overnight_vwap = on_cum_tpv / on_cum_vol

# =============================================================================
# BIAS ESTABLISHMENT (Price outside OR for consecutive bars)
# =============================================================================

# Price above OR high / below OR low
price_above_or_high = close > or_high_ff and is_valid(or_high_ff)
price_below_or_low = close < or_low_ff and is_valid(or_low_ff)

# Count consecutive bars outside OR using streak_length
bars_above_or = streak_length(direction=StreakDirection.up)(price_above_or_high)
bars_below_or = streak_length(direction=StreakDirection.up)(price_below_or_low)

# Bias established when price outside OR for 1+ consecutive bars after OR closes
# (On 5-min bars, even 1 bar shows initial breakout confirmation)
bullish_bias_trigger = bars_above_or >= 1 and is_trading_window
bearish_bias_trigger = bars_below_or >= 1 and is_trading_window

# Hold bias until end of day
bullish_bias = hold_until()(enter=bullish_bias_trigger, exit=is_exit_time)
bearish_bias = hold_until()(enter=bearish_bias_trigger, exit=is_exit_time)

# =============================================================================
# VWAP TOUCH DETECTION
# =============================================================================

# VWAP touch: price was away from VWAP and now touches it
# Touch defined as: bar's range includes VWAP level
ny_vwap_touch = low <= ny_vwap and high >= ny_vwap

# Alternative: crossover/crossunder for more precise touch
vwap_cross_down = crossunder(close, ny_vwap)
vwap_cross_up = crossover(close, ny_vwap)
vwap_touched = ny_vwap_touch or vwap_cross_down or vwap_cross_up

# =============================================================================
# ENTRY CONDITIONS
# =============================================================================

# Price position relative to both VWAPs
above_both_vwaps = close > ny_vwap and close > overnight_vwap
below_both_vwaps = close < ny_vwap and close < overnight_vwap

# Long entry: bullish bias + VWAP touch + price above both VWAPs + in trading window
long_entry_raw = bullish_bias and vwap_touched and above_both_vwaps and is_trading_window

# Short entry: bearish bias + VWAP touch + price below both VWAPs + in trading window
short_entry_raw = bearish_bias and vwap_touched and below_both_vwaps and is_trading_window

# Track if we've already entered today (max 1 position per day)
# Use hold_until to track daily entry state
entered_long_today = hold_until()(enter=long_entry_raw, exit=is_new_day)
entered_short_today = hold_until()(enter=short_entry_raw, exit=is_new_day)
entered_today = entered_long_today or entered_short_today

# First entry only - check if already entered on previous bar
already_entered = entered_today >> 1
first_long_entry = long_entry_raw and not already_entered
first_short_entry = short_entry_raw and not already_entered and not first_long_entry

# =============================================================================
# EXIT CONDITIONS
# =============================================================================

# Exit at 3:45pm NY time
exit_signal = is_exit_time

# =============================================================================
# EXECUTION
# =============================================================================

# Hold position from entry until exit time
held_long = hold_until()(enter=first_long_entry, exit=exit_signal)
held_short = hold_until()(enter=first_short_entry, exit=exit_signal)

# Entry/Exit zones
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long, short_entry=held_short)

# Position sizing - single position at 100%
is_in_position = held_long or held_short
position_weight = 100.0 if is_in_position else 0.0
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=position_weight)

# =============================================================================
# VISUALIZATION
# =============================================================================

# Plot VWAP levels
timeseries_lines(
    title="VWAP Levels",
    category="Indicators",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="NY Open VWAP", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Overnight VWAP", color=Color.Orange)
    ])
)(ny_vwap, overnight_vwap)

# Plot opening range levels
timeseries_lines(
    title="Opening Range",
    category="Indicators",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="OR High", color=Color.Green, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="OR Low", color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(or_high_ff, or_low_ff)

# Bias indicators
bullish_indicator = 1.0 if bullish_bias else 0.0
bearish_indicator = -1.0 if bearish_bias else 0.0
bias_signal = bullish_indicator + bearish_indicator

timeseries_lines(
    title="Bias Signal",
    category="Signals",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Bias (1=Bull, -1=Bear)", color=Color.Purple)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title="Neutral", color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(bias_signal)
